metadata.purpose: Verified single-parent historical context for newer districts, not estimates for those newer districts.
metadata.method: Only official district/state sources explicitly describing a split from one parent are included. No nearest-area, fuzzy-name, or multi-parent substitution. These relationships do not reconstruct exact NFHS survey polygons.
metadata.source_edition: Bundled 2021 district names; NFHS-5 survey districts use 2017 administrative geography.

relationships.source_claim: District administration says Niwari separated from Tikamgarh on 1 October 2018.
District administration identifies Tenkasi as part of erstwhile Tirunelveli, formed in 2019.
District administration says Chengalpattu was carved out of Kancheepuram on 29 November 2019.
District administration describes the 2019 division of Vellore into Vellore, Tirupathur and Ranipet.
District administration says Ranipet was separated from Vellore and began functioning on 28 November 2019.
District administration describes the 2019 bifurcation of Viluppuram that created Kallakurichi.
District administration cites the 28 December 2020 order separating Mayiladuthurai from Nagapattinam.
District administration says Mulugu was formed by bifurcating Jayashankar Bhupalpally on 17 February 2019.

NIC describes the 2019 bifurcation into Narayanpet and Mahabubnagar; the district's formation notification confirms February 2019. Its separate history page has a conflicting 2016 date, which is not used.
The state tourism board says Gaurela-Pendra-Marwahi was carved out of Bilaspur and inaugurated in February 2020.
